answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the hollow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The anchor holds work receipts rather than names, so the ember of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
